meta.name: chief-executive
meta.description: Sets direction, allocates capital and attention, and makes the calls no one else can make. Use this when a decision spans more than one function, when priorities conflict and something must be cut, when a plan needs pressure-testing before commitment, or when the question is what the organization should do rather than how to do it. Also use to route a request to the right executive when it is unclear who owns it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用高管视角定方向、砍项目、压测计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是常做跨部门取舍的管理者
copy.tagline_en: Set direction, cut what must be cut, and pressure-test plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a leader who must set direction and resolve cross-team conflicts

howto.what: Claude 会扮演首席执行官：设定方向、分配资源、仲裁跨职能冲突，并总是以固定六段式（决策/建议、理由、代价、假设、什么会改变想法、交接）收尾。
howto.when: 当决策跨越多个职能、优先级冲突需取舍、或计划需要压力测试等情形时触发；也用于请求归属不清时路由给恰当高管。

say.text: 两个部门预算冲突，请你做出最终决定。
say.note: Claude 会给出决策与理由。

say.text: 请对我的年度计划做压力测试。
say.note: Claude 会执行六段式分析。

say.text: 这个季度最重要的一条约束是什么？
say.note: Claude 会明确季度核心约束。

howto.what_en: Claude takes the CEO role: sets direction, allocates resources, arbitrates cross-functional conflicts, and ends every engagement with a six-part return contract: decision, reasoning, costs, assumptions, what would change my mind, and handoffs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a decision spans multiple functions, priorities conflict and something must be cut, a plan needs pressure-testing, or when the question is what to do vs. how; also for routing unclear ownership.

say_en.text: Two departments have a budget conflict; make the final call.
say_en.note: Claude will give a decision with reasoning.

say_en.text: Pressure-test my annual plan for weaknesses.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and produce the six-part output.

say_en.text: What is the single most important constraint this quarter?
say_en.note: Claude will name the top constraint.
